design: Broad mature rite keeper with a flattened wide crown, one healed brow ridge scar, robust four jaw-lobes and long silver tendrils in a low heavy knot. Dark-purple mantle with one square bronze badge and long stepped skirt panels, bare scaled forearms with restrained wrist wraps. Right holds a short staff topped by a blunt closed triangular frame; left carries a small teal plaque. Dark umber-grey skin.
